Omar Hassan: Hi all 👋 first day on Renewals CS. Quick access questions: HubSpot seat, Gong with clip-download enabled, Notion "Renewals Playbook v2", and the Looker 'Health Metrics' dashboard. Also need the renewal pricing cheat sheet and 1Password entry for demo accounts. Who do I bug?
Priya (Sales Ops): Welcome Omar 🎉 Sales Ops owns HubSpot/Notion/cheatsheets. Pinged IT for Gong and Looker. Please DM your login email so I can seed seats.
Omar Hassan: Sent DM (omar.hassan@redwood.com). Also, do renewals folks get a special HubSpot role for revenue stage editing?
Priya (Sales Ops): Yes — you'll get "Renewals AE" permissions which include revenue-stage edit. I'll request that.
IT Helpdesk: Okta invite sent to omar.hassan@redwood.com. Created ticket #IT-11027 for Gong clip permissions + Looker read. If Okta missing, try:
```
okta whoami --email omar.hassan@redwood.com
okta invite resend --email omar.hassan@redwood.com
```
CS Enablement: Hi Omar — I'm your enablement buddy. Renewals Playbook v2 is in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/Renewals-Playbook-v2-9a1b. Start at 'Week 0 > Renewal Scripts' and 'Objections > Pricing Compression'. The pricing cheat sheet is Drive -> Sales -> CS -> Pricing_Cheat_Sheet_2026.pdf.
Omar Hassan: Okta arrived. Notion 403 on that page. HubSpot SSO loops and shows "no seat". Cannot access Looker (403).
Access Bot: Access request #SALES-11400 created: HubSpot, Notion, Gong (clip-download=true), Looker dashboard read, Drive share, 1Password demo entry. Track: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SALES-11400
Priya (Sales Ops): Assigned the "Renewals AE" HubSpot seat. Try logging out and back in. If you see "insufficient permissions", click Request Access and tag me.
IT Helpdesk: Notion invite resent and Drive share applied. Looker access granted; you should receive an invite from looker@redwood.com. Gong clip permission toggled on for your account. If the Gong mail doesn't show, check Promotions. To verify in Gong run:
```
gong-cli users:get --email omar.hassan@redwood.com
```
Omar Hassan: HubSpot is working after re-login. Notion access works now. Looker invite landed; can see 'Health Metrics' dashboard. Drive shows pricing cheat sheet. Waiting on 1Password demo entry.
Priya (Sales Ops): 1Password item created under Sales / Sandboxes / Renewals-Demo. I'll share the 1Password note with you. Also, pro tip: in Notion there are copyable templates for post-renewal outreach — save one to your workspace.
CS Enablement: For first-week shadowing, join "Renewals-Shadow" calendar (Weds 10am) and "Live Review" (Thurs 3pm). We'll review your first three play recordings in Gong and mark clips for coaching.
Omar Hassan: Got the 1Password note and Gong access — clip download works. Thanks everyone, excited to get started 🚀
Access Bot: Update: HubSpot: done; Notion: done; Looker: done; Gong: done; Drive: done; 1Password: done. Ticket #SALES-11400 closed.
Omar Hassan: One last question — who approves exception pricing for renewals >20% off?
Priya (Sales Ops): Escalations for >20% go to Sales Leadership (cc your manager). Use the 'Discount Approval' form in Concur-Sales (link in Notion).
Omar Hassan: Perfect — thank you all! :raised_hands:
